particulars.description: The freehold property known as hillcrest manor nursing home, reabrook, minsterley, shrewsbury, SY5 0DL as the same is registered at hm land registry with title number SL45430 and any part or parts of it and including all rights attached or appurtenant to it and all buildings fixtures fittings plant and machinery from time to time situated on it.
Fixed and floating charge over all the assets and undertaking of the company.

See clause 3 of the instrument for full details of property to be secured to include; by way of legal mortgage the property known as hillcrest manor nursing home, reabrook, minsterly, shrewsbury, shropshire, SY5 0DL (title no: SL45430) and fixed plant/machinery owned by or charged to the company and from time to time on or in such freehold/leasehold property (“legally mortgaged property”) and/or the proceeds of sale of the legally mortgaged property; by way of fixed equitable charge all estates and interests in any freehold/leasehold property (except legally mortgaged property) belonging to or charged to the company and all licenses now or hereafter held by the company to enter upon or use land and the benefit of all other agreements relating to land which the company is or may become entitled and all buildings, fixtures and fixed plant and machinery owned by the company and from time to time on or in any freehold/leasehold property an interest in which is charged hereunder (“the equitably charged property”) and/or the proceeds of sale of the equitably charged property; by way of fixed charge all balances standing to the credit of any current, deposit or other account of the company with the bank; by way of fixed charge all stocks and/or other securities in any other body corporate whether or not certified and all rights in respect of or incidental to these securities; by way of fixed charge the goodwill and the uncalled capital of the company now or at any time hereafter in existence and future calls and the licences, patents, patent applications, trade names and rights in trademarks, copyrights, whether registered or not, rights in the nature of copyright, registered designs, know how, inventions, rights in confidential information, service marks and all other intellectual property rights; by way of fixed charge all plant, machinery, vehicles, computers and office and other equipment; and by way of floating charge its undertaking and all its other property, assets and rights whatsoever and wheresoever present and/or future, including those expressed as charged by way of fixed charge (the property/securities described above) if, and to the extent that, such charge may fail for any reason to operate as a fixed charge.

See clause 3 of the instrument for full details of property to be secured to include: by way of legal mortgage the property known as hillcrest manor nursing home, reabrook, minsterly, shrewsbury, shropshire, SY5 0DL (title no. SL45430); by way of fixed charge the goodwill; by way of fixed charge any share held by the mortgaged property in any tenants’, residents’ or occupiers management company affecting the mortgaged property or any estate or building which forms part; by way of floating security all moveable plant, machinery, implements, utensils, furniture, equipment, stock in trade, work in progress and other chattels of the mortgagor now and from time to time placed on or used in or about the mortgaged property such floating charge to crystallise upon the earlier of; (I) a demand being made for payment under clause 2 (covenant with the bank that it will on demand pay; or discharge to the bank) or (ii) the date of service of any notice given by the bank to the mortgagor pursuant to clause 3(2) (sets out when the bank can by written notice convert the floating security into a specific charge).

The freehold property known as hillcrest manor nursing home, reabrook, minsterley, shrewsbury, SY5 0DL as the same is registered at hm land registry with title no SL45430 and any part or parts of it and including all rights attached or appurtenant to it and all buildings fixtures fittings plant and machinery from time to time situated on it.

By way of first legal mortgage and any estate, right or interest in or over land, whether legal or equitable, and wherever the land is situated including, without limitation, any buildings and fixtures on land, and the benefit of any covenants or rights owed to any person or enforceable by him by virtue of the ownership possession or occupation of land but for these purposes "land" excludes heritable property situated in scotland vested in the chargor at the date of the charge;. All land acquired by the chargor after the date of this charge;. Any registered intellectual property right in any territory or jurisdiction, including, without limitation, patents, trademarks, service marks, registered designs, and any similar right in any territory or jurisdiction, and any application or right to apply for any of the above, any invention, copyright, design right or performance right, any trade secrets, knowhow and confidential information; and the benefit of any agreement or licence for the use of any such right.
A fixed and floating charge over all assets.
A legal mortgage over the freehold property known as hillcrest manor nursing home, reabrook, minsterley, shrewsbury, hm land registry title number: SL45430.
